999008199.text: 眩しい空
透き通る海
そして――
超絶かわいいアルビちゃんっ！！

さすが姉様。最も美しく眩しいわ。
今すぐ彫像をこしらえて、後世にこの美を残さないと

localizations.en: Truly, you are the most radiant of all. We should commission a statue right now, to preserve this beauty for generations to come.

999008199.text:
もう照れるやい！
てか、ベップもすごく似合ってるじゃん！

localizations.en: Oh, stop, you're making me blush! Besides, you look amazing in yours too!

999008199.text:
姉様が選んでくれた水着だもの。
完璧に着こなしてみせるわ

localizations.en: You picked it out for me. I intend to wear it perfectly.

999008199.text:
あ、いたー！
アルビーナもベップも、速いよー！

localizations.en: Oh, there you are! You two are so fast!

999008199.text: もー。到着早々迷子になったら笑えないよ～

localizations.en: Geez. Getting lost the second we arrive would not be a good look for us~

999008199.text: ごめーん。水着着たら気分上がっちゃった！

localizations.en: Sorry, sorry! I just got so excited once I put the swimsuit on!

999008199.text:
みんな、待たせてごめんね。
水着着るの、少し手間取っちゃった

localizations.en: Sorry for keeping everyone waiting. It took me a little while to get changed.

999008199.text:
ちょっと恥ずかしいけれど……
みんなと一緒なら、大丈夫かしら

localizations.en: I'm a bit embarrassed, but... if everyone's together, I think I'll be okay.

999008199.text:
おお……！　ヤンネさん、すっごく綺麗！！
うんうん、アタシの水着選びに狂いはなかった！

localizations.en: Whoa...! Janne, you look absolutely stunning!! Yep, my swimsuit-picking instincts are flawless!

999008199.text:
ヤンネさん、とっても素敵です！
イザナちゃんもかわいい！

localizations.en: You look wonderful, Janne! And Izana, you're adorable!

999008199.text: えへへ～！　ありがとう、レスナちゃん！
ふふ、みんなの着こなしには負けるわ

localizations.en: Hehe, I don't think I quite measure up to the rest of you.

999008199.text: ……あれ？　あんたたち、水着は？

localizations.en: ...Hm? What about you two? Where are your swimsuits?

999008199.text:
うぅ……忘れちゃったぁ……
水着を着るっていう感覚が今までなかったから……

localizations.en: Ugh... I forgot... I've just never had any reason to wear one before...

999008199.text: このままでも泳げる。支障はない

localizations.en: I can swim in this. It poses no issues.

999008199.text:
馬鹿ね。水着は海で一番動きやすい装備なのよ。
そんなんじゃ遅れをとるわ

localizations.en: Don't be ridiculous. A swimsuit is the most practical gear you can wear in the water. You'll fall behind like that.

999008199.text:
うーん……？
かわいいから着るんだと思うけどな……？

localizations.en: Hmm...? I thought people wore them because they're cute...?

999008199.text: ――なんだか、港に警備員が多くない？

localizations.en: —Say, isn't there an awful lot of security guards around the port?

999008199.text:
近海にでっかい魔物が出たんだってさ。
あと、諸島同盟外から偉い人が遊びに来ているとか……

localizations.en: Apparently some huge monster showed up in the nearby waters. And I heard some bigwig from outside the Archipelago Federation is visiting too...

999008199.text:
――姉、ヤド姉。
私たちも行こ！　みんな向こう行っちゃった

localizations.en: —Hey, Jadwiga. Come on, let's go! Everyone's heading over there.

999008199.text:
こんな風に過ごす休暇、初めてだから迷っちゃうね！
とりあえず甘いものが食べたいなぁ～

localizations.en: This is my first vacation like this, so I'm not sure where to start! I really want something sweet~

999008199.text: 諾。行こう、キューン

レスナの幼馴染で、王国騎士団に所属する獣人の少女。
レスナたちに誘われ、一緒にゼレンタ島へ来た

localizations.en: Resna's childhood friend and a beastkin girl who is now a member of the Royal Knights. She was invited by Resna and the others to join them on Zerenta Island.

999008199.text:
天才を自称する、レスナの友達の少女。
レスナたちに誘われ、一緒にゼレンタ島へ来た

localizations.en: A self-proclaimed genius and friend of Resna's. She was invited by Resna and the others to join them on Zerenta Island.
